subject: trs
title: TRS.------INFO.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 138 (AE(PD)-26). TRS (transition) is the subject; INFO-DY (information dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: BIA (bi-aitional), SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) and RT-ALGN (reality alignment). From BIA: C-RH (composite research) and VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From SOC-RT-DY: INFO-FR (information forum). From RT-ALGN: REL-TECH (relevant technology). From VT-DY: LANG-DY (language dynamics) and LG-DY (logical dynamics). From INFO-FR: MT-INFO-DB. From REL-TECH: ROTP (responsibility of the position). From LG-DY: RE-ST (restructuralism). From ROTP: SOC-PR (social programs), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of".
